items.diagnosis: E: uncertain acoustic start ownership, with possible A (preceding-vowel tail). The beginning of the 480 ms /i/ interval shows continuing periodic energy from the /ow/ transition, followed by lower energy and a later stronger /i/ region. This is compatible with the developer's excess-start observation, but a spectrogram cannot independently certify read-unit identity. No target onset/medial is represented; no neighbor MFA phone or export offset is included. Relevant target clipping is not established; quarantine.
